notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}{U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat for infinite {W}, {U} and {G}.
Activate Kinnan by paying {5}{U}{G}, looking at the top five cards of your library, putting a non-Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield, and putting the remaining cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 4 as many times as desired.
